Build a multi-tenant system: each customer’s data kept separate, with user roles and permissions, secure login and sessions. Background jobs with Redis: queues for long-running tasks such as imports, processing and report generation. File storage: store and serve documents and data files using S3-compatible object storage. Build the Windows agent: a Python tray application that connects securely to the cloud over WebSockets, receives jobs and sends back results. Browser automation with Selenium or Playwright: reliable automation of multi-step web workflows, with proper handling of sessions, timeouts, errors and retries always secure, and respecting each website’s rules Packaging and updates: build Windows installers for the agent and support automatic updates. Admin and internal tools: an operations admin panel for support, subscriptions and monitoring. Quality: automated tests (pytest), proper error handling, logging, code reviews, clean Git practice. Use AI every day: AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot, to build faster, with the judgement to check and correct AI-generated code. Work with our Chartered Accountants to turn business requirements into accurate, working features. Help guide interns and freshers on daily tasks and code. Must-have skills 2–3 years of hands-on software development experience. Strong Python with FastAPI. Experience with Flask or Django also counts. React (with JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS). PostgreSQL: good SQL, table design, joins, indexes. REST API design: authentication (JWT/sessions), validation, error handling. Browser automation: hands-on experience with Selenium or Playwright. Git , and writing clean, readable code. AI-first working: daily use of AI coding tools, with real examples of how it helped you deliver faster. Good communication in English. Telugu or Hindi is a plus. Strong plus Redis, and background job queues (Celery, RQ, ARQ, RabbitMQ or similar). WebSockets and async Python (asyncio). Multi-tenant SaaS: customer-level data separation, roles and permissions. Windows desktop or tray apps, and packaging Python apps (PyInstaller, Nuitka, Inno Setup, MSI). Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions), deployment to Linux, AWS, Azure or GCP. Automated testing with pytest. S3 or other object storage. Good to have GST, accounting, tax or fintech software experience. Payment gateway integration (Razorpay), email and SMS services, Google sign-in (OAuth). Vite, React Query, Tailwind CSS or similar modern frontend tools. Node.js or another backend language. No GST knowledge? No problem. Our Chartered Accountants will train you. We value strong engineering skills, attitude and willingness to learn. What we are NOT looking for Someone looking only for a comfortable, routine job. Someone who copies AI-generated code without understanding or checking it. Someone who builds automation that works once and breaks often. Someone who wants to restart everything from scratch. We build carefully on the work already done. Why join Nylun Global Private Limited Build a SaaS product from the ground up and see your work go live with businesses and CA firms across India. A real opportunity to prove yourself: your work directly shapes the product. Fast growth: a clear path to Senior Developer and Lead roles for people who perform. Modern stack: FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, WebSockets, automation, cloud and AI tools. AI-first culture: work the way modern engineering teams work. Learning: learn GST and fintech from experienced Chartered Accountants. Work directly with the founders , not through layers of management. Competitive salary: ₹3–6 lakh per annum based on skills and experience, with performance-based growth. Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year Work Location: In person

Git , and writing clean, readable code. AI-first working: daily use of AI coding tools, with real examples of how it helped you deliver faster. Good communication in English.
